title: Survey Builder
subtitle: Build surveys for lead registration
empty_body: Create a survey for your registration form
delete_survey_body: All questions and answers will be deleted.
delete_question_body: This question and all its answers will be deleted.

form_survey.heading: Application form survey
form_survey.body: The questions asked at the start of the public application form, before the applicant's own details. Leave it on “No survey” to skip that step entirely.
form_survey.inactive_warning: This survey is switched off, so the form skips it. Turn it Active to make it appear.
form_survey.empty_warning: This survey has no questions yet, so the form skips it. Add at least one question.

disqualify.help: Mark an option as rejecting to end the application there: whoever picks it is sent to the “Not eligible” page and never becomes a lead.
disqualify.marked_title: This answer disqualifies the applicant — click to undo

outcome_pages.heading: End pages of the application form
outcome_pages.body: The two pages an applicant lands on. Both are shown as one message in the middle of the page.
outcome_pages.fallback_hint: Leave the Arabic text empty to fall back to the French one.

qualified.label: Qualified
qualified.hint: Shown after the form is sent. The lead reaches your pipeline.

rejected.label: Not eligible
rejected.hint: Shown as soon as a rejecting answer is picked. No details are asked and no lead is created.
